description: This file defines the ProjectDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to decorate and manipulate Project entities, such as setting a customer by ID, adding project admins by employee numbers, and removing all project admins. The class uses traits and other entity references to extend functionality.

classes.name: ProjectDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Project entity, providing methods to modify associated data like customer and project admins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Project entity.

methods.name: setCustomerById
methods.description: Sets the customer for the project based on a customer ID.

methods.name: setProjectAdminsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds project admins to the project based on an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: addProjectAdmin
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as a project admin if not already present.

methods.name: removeProjectAdmins
methods.description: Removes all project admins from the project.
